ctx.x: In December, I played in Geneva, Switzerland , and gave a few concerts with some nice Swiss musicians, Henri Chaix, a pianist of the style of James P. Johnson, and Willie 'the Lion' Smith; Pierre Bourru, a good drummer,and Michel Pilet, a sax tenor, with a nice sound in the style of Hawkins.

In February 1968, I was elected a member of the French Academy du Jazz. The function of the Academy du Jazz is to pick the best jazz records issued during the year and give it an award. There were distinctions for different categories, Blues, New Orleans, Modern Jazz, Singers, etc. We would also elect the best French musician of the year.
